name: University of Virginia
header:
University of Virginia
United States · Mathematics PhD
Rank verification is maintained separately.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• Minimum 2 letters, math allows 2 or 3.
• Saving reference contact sends invitation.
• English waiver includes expected bachelor's, but degree must be entirely at English-medium institution.
• Craig Huneke, Leonard Scott, Charles Dunkl, Nicholas Kuhn and Harold Ward are emeriti in the current roster.
Ken Ono is on leave at Axiom Math despite appearing in the active directory. Ask each prospective adviser
about 2027 supervision and funding before relying on fit.
• Faculty below form a verified research-fit shortlist, not a complete census. New-student supervision and 2027
leave/moves must be confirmed; paper dates describe the cited version.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
UChicago bachelor's is appropriate preparation; graduate school expects undergraduate GPA at least 3.0. Math
ideally includes rigorous analysis, algebra, topology, complex analysis. [s1] [s2]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Only one GSAS application per cycle. Save referee contacts early (emails immediately). Upload English-waiver
evidence. [s2] [s3]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Committee-based admission; no prior supervisor agreement shown. Mathematical fit should guide faculty
contact. [s1]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Official Apply link uses applycentral.virginia.edu. FAQ explains prior-cycle document transfer and Interfolio. [s1]
[s3]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Math page identifies Fall 2027 and portal opened October 2026; funding rate not explicitly 2027-28. [s1]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
TOEFL/IELTS/DET or waiver. TOEFL old 90 with section minima 22 S/22 W/23 R/23 L; new 4.5 with 4 S/4.5 W/4.5
R/5L. IELTS 7 in each section; DET 130 with sectional minima. [s2]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Automatic if undergraduate degree earned/will be earned entirely at institution with English as primary
instruction. Submit transcript or language certificate as evidence. [s2]
GRE General [Standing rule]
Not required for Mathematics; department does not establish how optional general scores are used. [s2]
GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Optional unofficial scores accepted; explicitly no penalty for omission. [s1]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Standing rule]
Graduate school states USD 37,260 for 12-month living support plus tuition, fees and single-person health
insurance remission. This is a school minimum, not a verified 2027 math offer. [s5]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Almost all math PhD students guaranteed 5 years, annually conditional on progress; school promises minimum
5-year support. [s4] [s5]
International eligibility [Unresolved]
This particular funding term was not established by the public program/admissions material checked. Obtain
the exact rule in the funding offer or from the graduate coordinator; neither eligibility nor a guaranteed
amount/duration is inferred from silence. [s1] [s2] [s3]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Satisfactory progress; usually teaching, with 2 teaching-free semesters. Summer support linked to continued
progress. [s4]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
No separate aid form; automatic consideration with PhD admission application. [s4]

Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Department nominations for Jefferson Fellowships; research grants/outside awards; current-student travel
support. Citizenship and extra 2027 materials need award-specific confirmation. [s4]
Application fee [Standing rule]
USD 85 nonrefundable at submission. [s2]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Automatic based on citizenship for current listed UN least-developed countries; international applicants outside
list do not qualify for this route. Organization-based waiver eligibility is separate. No waiver codes. [s2]

sections.title: Potential advisers and recent research
sections.text:
Algebraic / arithmetic geometry
Evangelia Gazaki
Arithmetic of algebraic cycles, curves and abelian varieties, Galois cohomology and p-adic Hodge theory;
zero-cycles on Kummer K3 surfaces. [faculty1] [faculty1a]
Current faculty; new PhD supervision availability unconfirmed.
Research evidence: 2026 · Local and local-to-global principles for zero-cycles on geometrically Kummer K3 surfaces
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Andrei Rapinchuk
Arithmetic of algebraic groups, algebraic tori, Galois cohomology and local-global finiteness over function
fields. [faculty3]
Current faculty; new PhD supervision availability unconfirmed.
Research evidence: 2024 · The finiteness of the Tate-Shafarevich group over function fields for algebraic tori defined over the
base field
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Peter Abramenko
Buildings and algebraic groups, including reductive groups over polynomial rings and torsors over the affine
line. [faculty4] [faculty4a]
Current faculty; new PhD supervision availability unconfirmed.
Research evidence: 2024 journal issue; online 2023 · Applications of the Fixed Point Theorem for group actions on buildings to
algebraic groups over polynomial rings
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Number theory
Peter Humphries
Analytic number theory, automorphic forms, representation theory and L-functions; spectral reciprocity and
Rankin-Selberg subconvexity. [faculty6] [faculty6a]

Current faculty; new PhD supervision availability unconfirmed.
Research evidence: 2026 preprint · Rankin-Selberg Subconvexity via Spectral Reciprocity
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Ken Ono
Number theory, modular-form/partition phenomena and combinatorics, with current AI/data-science interests.
[faculty8] [faculty8a]
Commonwealth Professor, explicitly on leave; Founding Mathematician at Axiom Math. Availability and leave end date for a 2027
PhD must be confirmed.
Research evidence: 2026 · Partition functions that repel perfect-powers
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Representation theory
You Qi
Higher representation theory, small quantum groups and categorification, with algebraic-geometry and
low-dimensional topology links. [faculty10] [faculty10a]
Current faculty; new PhD supervision availability unconfirmed.
Research evidence: 2026 preprint · Colored Khovanov homology theories at prime roots of unity
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Weiqiang Wang
Quantum groups and symmetric pairs, canonical bases, Hecke algebras, Lie superalgebras and
geometric/categorical representation theory. [faculty12]
Current faculty; new PhD supervision availability unconfirmed.
Research evidence: 2026 · Affine iquantum groups and Steinberg varieties of type C
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Jennifer Morse
Algebraic combinatorics at its representation-theory/Schubert-calculus interface: symmetric functions,
Macdonald/LLT polynomials and crystals. [faculty13]
Current faculty; new PhD supervision availability unconfirmed.
Research evidence: 2025 preprint · The nonsymmetric shuffle theorem
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Mikhail Ershov
Adjacent algebra fit: pro-p and arithmetic/group-theoretic methods, Kazhdan property (T), Kac-Moody groups,
and automorphisms of free groups. [faculty14] [faculty14a]
Current faculty; new PhD supervision availability unconfirmed.
Research evidence: 2026 preprint · On finite presentability of some partial Torelli subgroups of Aut(F_n)
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Haihan Wu
Quantum topology, categorification and web categories for Lie-algebra representations. [faculty19] [faculty19a]
Whyburn Research Associate and Lecturer at UVA under You Qi; formerly JHU Simons postdoc 2024-26, visiting IPAM Fall 2026.
Temporary research appointment; independent primary PhD supervision not established.
Research evidence: 2026 preprint · 6-valent vertex in the gl(N) web category and its categorification
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.

Complex geometry
Sara Maloni
Higher Teichmüller theory, character varieties of surface groups, Anosov representations and
hyperbolic/complex-projective geometry; adjacent to the requested representation/complex-geometry
interests. [faculty16] [faculty16a]
Current faculty; new PhD supervision availability unconfirmed.
Research evidence: 2026 preprint / forthcoming book chapter · Dynamics and geometry of character varieties for surface
groups
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.

University of Virginia
United States · Mathematics PhD
Rank verification is maintained separately.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• Minimum 2 letters, math allows 2 or 3.
• Saving reference contact sends invitation.
• English waiver includes expected bachelor's, but degree must be entirely at English-medium institution.
• Craig Huneke, Leonard Scott, Charles Dunkl, Nicholas Kuhn and Harold Ward are emeriti in the current roster.
Ken Ono is on leave at Axiom Math despite appearing in the active directory. Ask each prospective adviser
about 2027 supervision and funding before relying on fit.
• Faculty below form a verified research-fit shortlist, not a complete census. New-student supervision and 2027
leave/moves must be confirmed; paper dates describe the cited version.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
UChicago bachelor's is appropriate preparation; graduate school expects undergraduate GPA at least 3.0. Math
ideally includes rigorous analysis, algebra, topology, complex analysis. [s1] [s2]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Only one GSAS application per cycle. Save referee contacts early (emails immediately). Upload English-waiver
evidence. [s2] [s3]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Committee-based admission; no prior supervisor agreement shown. Mathematical fit should guide faculty
contact. [s1]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Official Apply link uses applycentral.virginia.edu. FAQ explains prior-cycle document transfer and Interfolio. [s1]
[s3]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Math page identifies Fall 2027 and portal opened October 2026; funding rate not explicitly 2027-28. [s1]
Deadlines by stage
Academic application [2027 confirmed]
January 15, 2027: math page identifies Fall 2027 portal and Jan 15 deadline. Timezone/cutoff not stated. [s1]
[s6]
Funding consideration [Standing rule]
All math PhD applicants automatically considered; no extra aid form. Apply by Jan 15. [s4]
Reference receipt [Unresolved]
No distinct reference receipt grace date verified; arrange by January 15. Applicant may submit before letters
arrive. [s2] [s3]

Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
Self-report with application. Official scores only if matriculating; send before expiry if scores expire before July.
[s2]
Supporting documents [Standing rule]
Complete application due January 15; no separate public supporting-document deadline found. [s1] [s2]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
No binding program-wide acceptance deadline for Fall 2027 was established in the public admissions pages
checked. Use the individual offer and ask the program if unclear; do not infer April 15 merely from an earlier
CGS signatory list. [s1] [s2] [s3]
English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
TOEFL/IELTS/DET or waiver. TOEFL old 90 with section minima 22 S/22 W/23 R/23 L; new 4.5 with 4 S/4.5 W/4.5
R/5L. IELTS 7 in each section; DET 130 with sectional minima. [s2]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Automatic if undergraduate degree earned/will be earned entirely at institution with English as primary
instruction. Submit transcript or language certificate as evidence. [s2]
GRE General [Standing rule]
Not required for Mathematics; department does not establish how optional general scores are used. [s2]
GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Optional unofficial scores accepted; explicitly no penalty for omission. [s1]
Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Upload entire postsecondary academic record, unofficial accepted; no mailed originals for review. English
translations where needed. Official undergraduate record after admission. [s2]
Mathematics-course list [Unresolved]
The public admissions checklist checked does not establish a separate mathematics course-list requirement.
Confirm any portal-only supplement and its format; omission here does not mean unsolicited uploads are
permitted. [s1] [s2] [s3]
Course descriptions [Unresolved]
The public admissions checklist checked does not establish a separate course-description/textbook-list
requirement. Confirm any portal-only supplement and its format; omission here does not mean unsolicited
uploads are permitted. [s1] [s2] [s3]
Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
2 or 3 on math checklist; graduate school minimum 2. Three can be supplied. [s1] [s2]
Scholarship references; Receipt confirmation [Unresolved]
This specific reference detail was not established by the public program/graduate application instructions
checked. Confirm it in the current referee-help screen or with admissions before entering contacts; no
invitation was triggered during research. [s1] [s2] [s3]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
Saving reference contact information emails instructions immediately. [s2]

Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Application may be submitted independently of arriving letters. [s2] [s3]
Updating and reusing letters [Standing rule]
Interfolio accepted via unique reference email. Prior application materials retained 1 year; after new
submission, request transfer through Admissions. Valid official scores transfer automatically. Submitted-letter
edits not explained. [s3]
Written materials
Academic CV / resume [Unresolved]
Not in department checklist; optional portal availability/format/limit not established. [s1]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Required upload 500-1000 words. Prompt paraphrase: reasons for UVA/program, preparation, specific research
questions/interests, career plans, intellectual/life experiences demonstrating aptitude and motivation. File/font
rules not stated. [s2]
Personal / background statement [Standing rule]
Life experiences may be included in SOP. Separate background statement not listed. [s2]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Required content of SOP; separate research-interest document not listed. [s2]
Research proposal; Publications list; Course-list document; Scholarship essays; Other short
answers / materials [Unresolved]
The public mathematics and graduate-admissions pages checked do not establish a separate requirement or
permission to submit this item. Required/optional status, exact prompt, length, formatting and
upload-versus-link instructions remain unverified; check the current portal before drafting or sending an extra
document. [s1] [s2] [s3]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Standing rule]
Not required under graduate school list: Mathematics is absent from programs requiring writing samples.
Optional full-paper upload/link permission unverified. [s2]
Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [Standing rule]
Graduate school states USD 37,260 for 12-month living support plus tuition, fees and single-person health
insurance remission. This is a school minimum, not a verified 2027 math offer. [s5]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Almost all math PhD students guaranteed 5 years, annually conditional on progress; school promises minimum
5-year support. [s4] [s5]
International eligibility [Unresolved]
This particular funding term was not established by the public program/admissions material checked. Obtain
the exact rule in the funding offer or from the graduate coordinator; neither eligibility nor a guaranteed
amount/duration is inferred from silence. [s1] [s2] [s3]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Satisfactory progress; usually teaching, with 2 teaching-free semesters. Summer support linked to continued
progress. [s4]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
No separate aid form; automatic consideration with PhD admission application. [s4]

Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Department nominations for Jefferson Fellowships; research grants/outside awards; current-student travel
support. Citizenship and extra 2027 materials need award-specific confirmation. [s4]
Application fee [Standing rule]
USD 85 nonrefundable at submission. [s2]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Automatic based on citizenship for current listed UN least-developed countries; international applicants outside
list do not qualify for this route. Organization-based waiver eligibility is separate. No waiver codes. [s2]
Conflicts and remaining checks
Conflicting sources [Standing rule]
Older international fee-waiver PDF has broader country list than current requirements; use current list. [s2]
Checks still needed [Unresolved]
Confirm exact reference grace/receipt/update rules,2027 stipend, international award-specific eligibility,
CV/supplement upload options, commitment deadline. [s1] [s2] [s4]
